Personal data protection

How VISUN AI receives and uses information when a visitor contacts us through this website.

Updated: 14 September 2026

1. Information we receive

When you request a consultation, VISUN AI may receive your name, role, company, email address, phone number and the business problem you choose to describe.

2. How the information is used

We use this information to respond, prepare for a discussion, suggest an appropriate scope and maintain communication directly related to your request.

3. Processing principles

  • Collect only information necessary for the stated purpose.
  • Do not request sensitive or confidential business data through a public form.
  • Do not sell personal information to third parties.
  • Share data with technical support providers only when necessary and with appropriate controls.

4. Your rights

You may ask to review, correct or delete information you submitted by emailing infor.visun@gmail.com. We will verify the request before taking action.

5. Project information

Do not submit passwords, access keys, employee records, health data, financial data or trade secrets through the public contact channel. Project data is agreed during discovery and governed by appropriate documentation.

6. Contact

Email: infor.visun@gmail.com · Phone: 0986 315 286.
